Required structural sections (Context/Problem for all plans, Approach/Scope for leaves, graph-backed decomposition for containers) lack deterministic validation despite being documented requirements
Acceptance criteria lack mechanically verifiable proof linkage; current implementation does not require explicit verification clauses or operator attestation
Scope and Approach sections admit placeholder language (TBD, figure out, depends on investigation) that signals incomplete planning but is not penalized deterministically
